verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own docs say users describe a change in plain English and LightSprint's agents build it with a live preview. They also describe built-in onboarding agents, background cloud agents that clear bug backlogs, and cloud-launched first-party agents, so delegation to a built-in AI assistant is the product's core. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth docs on how users interact with the assistant (most evidence is marketing-page copy).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe the change in plain English. LightSprint builds it, spins up a live preview, and prepares for engineering review.
Clear your bug backlog with background cloud agents
LightSprint's onboarding agent will set up your codebase, environment variables and setup script automatically.
launch our agents in the cloud. LightSprint tracks all PRs and manages ticket state
